questions.question: Problem statement:The supervisor of the manufacturing process prefers to have a RED LED to turn ON when either tank A(input button1) or tank B (input button 2) or both tank levels drop below ¼ full-level.
What modification would be required in the external circuit (limiting resistor & RED LED) connected to the output of NAND gate?

answers.a: The cathode of RED LED should be connected to + 5 V.
answers.b: The cathode of RED LED should be connected to ground.

questions.question: If external connections are done according to the solution of Q.1; then we refer to the IC as _____________ current.
The output of NAND gate is LOW __________

answers.c: When tanks A & B both are empty.
answers.d: when tank A or B is empty
